fruits.extendedStory: Two disasters shaped this building. Fire took it in 1435, and Onofrio della Cava put it back together. Then the powder stored inside went up in 1463 and took it down again. The city looked at Michelozzo's repair design in 1464 and said no. Salvi di Michele got the job from 1467, and his is the front you see.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Im Palast lagerte das Schießpulver der Stadt. 1435 brannte er nieder, und Onofrio della Cava baute ihn wieder auf. 1463 riss ihn eine Pulverexplosion erneut auf. Michelozzo legte einen Entwurf für die Reparatur vor, den die Stadt 1464 ablehnte. Von 1467 an führte Salvi di Michele die Arbeit weiter, und daher stammt der Bau, vor dem du stehst.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Two disasters shaped this building. Fire took it in 1435, and Onofrio della Cava put it back together. Then the powder stored inside went up in 1463 and took it down again. The city looked at Michelozzo's repair design in 1464 and said no. Salvi di Michele got the job from 1467, and his is the front you see.

localizedStory.de: Dieser Palast ist zweimal verschwunden. 1435 brannte er, 1463 sprengte ihn das Pulver in seinem Keller.
localizedStory.en: This palace has vanished twice. It burned in 1435, and in 1463 the gunpowder in its own store blew it open.

fruits.name: Knežev dvor
fruits.story: This palace has vanished twice. It burned in 1435, and in 1463 the gunpowder in its own store blew it open.

fruits.extendedStory: Master Mihoje Brajkov of Bar built the friary in 1360. The lower cloister stands on 120 columns and twelve heavy piers. The earthquake of 1667 brought the church down. The carved portal of 1498 came through it standing. The library holds over 20,000 books, among them 1,200 old manuscripts and 137 incunables, and the pharmacy outlasted all of it.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Meister Mihoje Brajkov aus Bar baute das Kloster 1360. Der untere Kreuzgang steht auf 120 Säulen und zwölf schweren Pfeilern. Das Erdbeben von 1667 legte die Kirche nieder und ließ nur das geschnitzte Portal von 1498 stehen. Die Bibliothek hat über 20.000 Bände, darunter 1.200 alte Handschriften und 137 Wiegendrucke. Die Apotheke von 1317 aber hat all das überdauert.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Master Mihoje Brajkov of Bar built the friary in 1360. The lower cloister stands on 120 columns and twelve heavy piers. The earthquake of 1667 brought the church down. The carved portal of 1498 came through it standing. The library holds over 20,000 books, among them 1,200 old manuscripts and 137 incunables, and the pharmacy outlasted all of it.

localizedStory.de: Die Apotheke hier arbeitet seit 1317. Es ist die älteste Europas, die nie geschlossen hat.
localizedStory.en: The pharmacy here has been working since 1317. It is the oldest in Europe that never closed.

fruits.name: Sv. Franjo
fruits.story: The pharmacy here has been working since 1317. It is the oldest in Europe that never closed.

fruits.extendedStory: Nikifor Ranjina put a square tower here in 1319. From 1445 it was rebuilt round, behind an outer wall that had run from here to Bokar since 1351. Michelozzo Michelozzi was given the job of modernising the walls. Juraj Dalmatinac took the tower on after him, and Paskoje Miličević finished it late in the 15th century. Three master builders on one tower.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Nikifor Ranjina setzte 1319 einen viereckigen Turm hierher. Ab 1445 baute man ihn rund um, hinter einer Außenmauer, die seit 1351 von hier bis Bokar lief. Michelozzo Michelozzi bekam die Aufgabe, die Mauern zu erneuern. Juraj Dalmatinac übernahm den Turm nach ihm, und Paskoje Miličević machte ihn im späten 15. Jahrhundert fertig. Drei Baumeister an einem Turm.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Nikifor Ranjina put a square tower here in 1319. From 1445 it was rebuilt round, behind an outer wall that had run from here to Bokar since 1351. Michelozzo Michelozzi was given the job of modernising the walls. Juraj Dalmatinac took the tower on after him, and Paskoje Miličević finished it late in the 15th century. Three master builders on one tower.

localizedStory.de: Der Turm begann 1319 viereckig. Rund wurde er später, als die Mauern schwerer werden mussten.
localizedStory.en: The tower began square in 1319. It went round later, when the walls had to grow heavier.

fruits.name: Minčeta
fruits.story: The tower began square in 1319. It went round later, when the walls had to grow heavier.

fruits.extendedStory: Antonio Ferramolino drew it and the Senate approved the drawings in 1538. The building took eleven years. Revelin stands detached outside the wall, covering the land approach to the eastern Ploče gate. When it was done it was the strongest fortress the city had. A fort set out on its own keeps trouble at a distance from the wall itself.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Antonio Ferramolino legte die Zeichnungen vor, und der Senat nahm sie 1538 an. Elf Jahre dauerte der Bau. Revelin steht abgesetzt vor der Mauer und deckt den Landweg zum östlichen Tor von Ploče. Als es fertig war, war es das stärkste Fort, das Dubrovnik besaß. Ein Fort, das allein draußen steht, hält den Feind auf Abstand von der Mauer.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Antonio Ferramolino drew it and the Senate approved the drawings in 1538. The building took eleven years. Revelin stands detached outside the wall, covering the land approach to the eastern Ploče gate. When it was done it was the strongest fortress the city had. A fort set out on its own keeps trouble at a distance from the wall itself.

localizedStory.de: Der Senat nahm die Pläne 1538 an. Elf Jahre später war das stärkste Fort der Stadt fertig.
localizedStory.en: The Senate took the drawings in 1538. Eleven years later the city's strongest fort was finished.

fruits.name: Revelin
fruits.story: The Senate took the drawings in 1538. Eleven years later the city's strongest fort was finished.

fruits.extendedStory: Orthodox families came here from Herzegovina after the earthquake of 1667. For two hundred years the Senate refused them a church of their own. In 1867 they were finally able to buy the ground, and by 1877 the building stood on it, Byzantine in manner. The museum beside it keeps icons painted in the 15th and 16th centuries, with robes, chalices and silver. Some of it is older than the church around it.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Nach dem Erdbeben von 1667 kamen orthodoxe Familien aus der Herzegowina hierher. Zweihundert Jahre lang verweigerte ihnen der Senat eine eigene Kirche. 1867 konnten sie endlich den Grund kaufen, 1877 stand der Bau darauf, byzantinisch in der Form. Im Museum daneben hängen Ikonen aus dem 15. und 16. Jahrhundert, dazu Gewänder, Kelche und Silber. Manches davon ist älter als die Kirche selbst.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Orthodox families came here from Herzegovina after the earthquake of 1667. For two hundred years the Senate refused them a church of their own. In 1867 they were finally able to buy the ground, and by 1877 the building stood on it, Byzantine in manner. The museum beside it keeps icons painted in the 15th and 16th centuries, with robes, chalices and silver. Some of it is older than the church around it.

localizedStory.de: Zweihundert Jahre lang durfte diese Gemeinde keine eigene Kirche bauen. 1877 stand sie.
localizedStory.en: For two hundred years this community was refused a church of its own. In 1877 it stood.

fruits.name: Crkva sv. Blagovještenja
fruits.story: For two hundred years this community was refused a church of its own. In 1877 it stood.

fruits.extendedStory: Andrea Pozzo drew this church, built between 1699 and 1725. Pietro Passalacqua added a broad stone stair below it in 1738, shaped after Rome's Spanish Steps. So climbing up is as much a monument as what waits at its top. Marin Gundulić, a Jesuit of this city, left money for all of it by will. Work ran from 1653 to 1765, more than a hundred years for one square.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Jesuiten bauten diese Kirche zwischen 1699 und 1725, nach einem Entwurf von Andrea Pozzo. Er ging von Il Gesù in Rom aus und formte es für einen Hang um. 1738 setzte Pietro Passalacqua die Treppe davor und lieh sich die Form der Spanischen Treppe. Bezahlt wurde alles aus dem Vermächtnis eines Dubrovniker Jesuiten, Marin Gundulić. Gebaut wurde von 1653 bis 1765, über hundert Jahre für einen Platz.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Andrea Pozzo drew this church, built between 1699 and 1725. Pietro Passalacqua added a broad stone stair below it in 1738, shaped after Rome's Spanish Steps. So climbing up is as much a monument as what waits at its top. Marin Gundulić, a Jesuit of this city, left money for all of it by will. Work ran from 1653 to 1765, more than a hundred years for one square.

localizedStory.de: Über eine breite Steintreppe geht es zu dieser Kirche hinauf. Ihr Baumeister nahm sich die Spanische Treppe in Rom zum Vorbild.
localizedStory.en: More than a hundred years went into this church and its stair. One Jesuit's will paid for all of it.

fruits.name: Crkva sv. Ignacija
fruits.story: More than a hundred years went into this church and its stair. One Jesuit's will paid for all of it.

fruits.extendedStory: The fort stands on the south east side of the old port and commands the way in. When danger showed, the town closed the harbour with heavy chains, strung from here across to the Kase jetty. Anyone unwelcome simply could not get in. Paskoje Miličević laid the harbour out in the late 15th century. Boats come and go freely now, where the chain once hung.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Das Fort steht an der Südostseite des alten Hafens und beherrscht die Einfahrt. Drohte Gefahr, schloss die Stadt den Hafen mit schweren Ketten, von hier hinüber zur Mole Kase. Wer nicht erwünscht war, kam nicht hinein. Paskoje Miličević legte den Hafen gegen Ende des 15. Jahrhunderts an. Heute laufen Boote frei ein, wo die Kette hing.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The fort stands on the south east side of the old port and commands the way in. When danger showed, the town closed the harbour with heavy chains, strung from here across to the Kase jetty. Anyone unwelcome simply could not get in. Paskoje Miličević laid the harbour out in the late 15th century. Boats come and go freely now, where the chain once hung.

localizedStory.de: Von diesem Fort spannte die Stadt eine schwere Kette quer über die Hafeneinfahrt.
localizedStory.en: From this fort the city stretched a heavy chain right across the harbour mouth.

fruits.name: Sv. Ivan
fruits.story: From this fort the city stretched a heavy chain right across the harbour mouth.

fruits.extendedStory: A casemate fort has vaulted chambers built into the wall, so guns could fire from inside without bringing the roof down. Michelozzo built this one two storeys high between 1461 and 1463. No older fort of that kind is still standing in Europe. The military engineer Antonio Ferramolina altered it again in 1570. Between them, it and Minčeta held the ditch and the Pile gate.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Ein Kasemattenfort hat gewölbte Kammern in der Mauer, aus denen Geschütze feuern konnten, ohne dass die Decke einstürzte. Michelozzo baute diesen zweigeschossig zwischen 1461 und 1463. Kein älterer seiner Art steht heute noch in Europa. Der Militäringenieur Antonio Ferramolina änderte ihn 1570 noch einmal. Zusammen mit Minčeta hielt er den Graben und das Tor von Pile.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A casemate fort has vaulted chambers built into the wall, so guns could fire from inside without bringing the roof down. Michelozzo built this one two storeys high between 1461 and 1463. No older fort of that kind is still standing in Europe. The military engineer Antonio Ferramolina altered it again in 1570. Between them, it and Minčeta held the ditch and the Pile gate.

localizedStory.de: Michelozzo baute diesen Rundturm zwischen 1461 und 1463. Kein älterer Kasemattenbau steht noch in Europa.
localizedStory.en: Michelozzo built this round fort between 1461 and 1463. No older one of its kind still stands in Europe.

fruits.name: Bokar
fruits.story: Michelozzo built this round fort between 1461 and 1463. No older one of its kind still stands in Europe.
